data.name: Four Hour Private Charter
data.description:
#A Private Harbor Cruise on the Best Catamaran Yacht in San Diego!

##Schedule
Monday - Sunday
Year Round

Triton Charters is San Diego’s largest and newest Catamaran. Our yacht can accommodate up to 100 guests and is perfect for group events. We specialize in weddings, bachelorette/bachelor parties, birthday bashes, family/friend outings, corporate events and much more! Triton presents a modern aesthetic with spacious open seating, an advanced 13-seat bar, a vibrant dance floor, and even includes a built-in water slide. We thought of everything to make your group outing perfect, so you don’t have to!

meeting_point.address: 2700 Shelter Island Dr. San Diego, CA US 92106

data.cancellation_notes:
2026 Bookings: Private Charters have a 3-week cancellation policy. To receive a full refund of your deposit you must cancel your reservation 3 weeks prior to the event. If canceled within the 3 weeks you will forfeit your deposit. You have the option to reschedule at no charge up until 1 week prior to departure. Your reservation is not eligible for a refund 1 week prior to your event.

Triton will go out rain or shine unless the captain deems conditions unsafe to be on the water. If the captain makes that decision you will be contacted by a team member to go over your options to rebook.
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for choosing Triton Charters! We are so excited to have you aboard! Please review the details below including parking and walking directions to get to the boat. 

###Parking Directions:
When you arrive at our address 2700 Shelter Island Drive, San Diego 92106 you will see a large parking lot on the right located in front of the Brigantine restaurant. For free parking, please park in the rear of the parking lot as there are no meters. We do not have assigned parking, so please be sure to arrive at least 30 minutes prior to departure. Google Maps: [Triton Charters](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Triton+Charters/@32.7213411,-117.2299103,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m5!3m4!1s0x80deab7fd72e5973:0x221232ad56159d50!8m2!3d32.7213366!4d-117.2277216)

###Walking Directions:
Once parked cross to the other side of the street on Shelter Island Drive and the path to the docks has yellow markers on the corner. The dock path is located between Intrepid Boat Works and San Diego Marine Exchange. Once on the dock path the boat is located at the second black gate. **Check-in will be directly at the gate.** Please fill out your waivers prior to arrival! 

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/CRKAxXmNQpmKIVXYMu9N)

##Cruise Features
- Coast Guard certified captain and crew along with a bartender to assist you on your charter. 
- Cruise by some of the most iconic San Diego monuments including the USS Midway, Star of India, and the Coronado Bridge.
- Triton offers draft beer, wine, mixed drinks, specialty cocktails and non alcoholic drinks on board for purchase. 
- Plenty of seating for large groups including bean bags on the bow for lounging.
- 2 upscale modern bathrooms
- A professional Bluetooth sound system and dance floor
- A 55" television to play a slideshow or display a company logo
- Built-in water slide and sturdy trampoline netting 

###Private Charter Details
- Now that your charter is confirmed an Event Coordinator will reach out to go over food and beverage options and will be sending your proposal and contract. Please make sure to sign your contract upon receiving as this confirms the booking and allows us to start the planning process. 
- With a private event you have the option to customize your charter to fit your needs. We have different bar options, great preferred vendors and water toy add-ons! Your coordinator will be your direct point of contact and is happy to answer any questions and provide additional information regarding your charter.

###Please note:
- You must arrive AT LEAST 30 minutes before your charter time. Check in will be directly at the boat. Please have your guests fill out their waivers prior to arrival, and have ID's handy before you arrive! 
- All outside beverage containers must be emptied before boarding Triton Charters. You will be able to refill your container with water after boarding. 
- For the safety and enjoyment of all guests, parents and guardians are responsible for supervising their children at all times while on board. We kindly ask that all guests be mindful of others, as we reserve the right to remove any individuals, including minors, whose behavior is disruptive or unsafe.
- Film Production and Drone Filming are prohibited without approval. 
- Jumping off the boat without approval will forfeit your charter. 
- Any illegal or lewd activities will automatically end and forfeit your charter. 
- No smoking is allowed on board.
- Visibly intoxicated passengers are not allowed to board the yacht.
- Outside alcoholic beverages are not permitted and will be disposed of before boarding.
- No animals are allowed on board.
- The Triton is sanitized before, during, and after every charter. Hand sanitizer is available.
